info.title: CurDemoTwo Computation and Execution API
info.description: 标准计算作业不写库存；文件模式单实例，JDBC 模式支持租约调度。二维、唛架与一维适配能力以 capabilities 为准。执行单接口关联已保存的二维业务任务方案，与库存共享事务；整卷/整块预约、开工、报工和取消已实现。不可变库存/需求流水与内部对账已实现；本机 stdio MCP 适配器调用相同 REST 用例；身份认证、多材料、外部库存对账及远程 MCP 尚待实现。

post.summary: Atomically move 1-100 inventory materials and post a document plus journal
post.description: Expected revision comes from options. Reserved/running materials, consumed or scrapped remnants cannot move. Quarantine status is preserved. Same key and identical command returns the original document before revision checking. Correct an old move using a new document; no delete/update. File mode supports one application instance. Operator is manually declared until authentication is implemented.

400.description: Invalid or missing fields, empty materials, duplicate material, same location

409.description: Inventory revision, reservation, material availability or idempotency conflict

get.description: Only equal hard constraints and equal metric unit/basis/version permit numeric deltas. Engine, time budget, objective/profile and orchestration strategy may differ.
